_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: products
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (category_id, organization_id) REFERENCES categories (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (unit_id, organization_id) REFERENCES units (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (tax_category_id, organization_id) REFERENCES tax_categories (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: product_barcodes
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

data.name: product_prices
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((branch_id IS NULL AND branch_scope = '*') OR (branch_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_scope = branch_id))

data.name: product_images
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE CASCADE

data.name: stock_locations
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (location_type IN ('sales_floor', 'warehouse', 'returns', 'damaged'))

data.name: inventory_transactions
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (status IN ('posted', 'reversed'))

CHECK (transaction_type IN ('opening_balance', 'purchase_receipt', 'sale', 'sale_return', 'adjustment_increase', 'adjustment_decrease', 'transfer_shipment', 'transfer_receipt', 'stock_count_correction', 'reversal'))

data.name: inventory_ledger_entries
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (stock_location_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: inventory_balances
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (stock_location_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: stock_counts
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (stock_location_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (count_type IN ('full', 'cycle'))
CHECK (status IN ('in_progress', 'completed', 'cancelled'))

data.name: stock_count_items
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (stock_count_id, organization_id) REFERENCES stock_counts (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: registers
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (printer_type != 'network_esc_pos' OR (printer_address IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(printer_address)) > 0))

data.name: shifts
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (register_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES registers (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (status IN ('open', 'closed'))
CHECK ((status = 'open' AND closed_at IS NULL AND closed_by_user_id IS NULL) OR (status = 'closed' AND closed_at IS NOT NULL AND closed_by_user_id IS NOT NULL))

data.name: cash_movements
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (register_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES registers (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (shift_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES shifts (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (movement_type IN ('cash_in', 'cash_out', 'payout', 'correction'))
CHECK ((movement_type = 'cash_in' AND amount_minor > 0) OR (movement_type IN ('cash_out', 'payout') AND amount_minor < 0) OR (movement_type = 'correction' AND amount_minor <> 0))

data.name: shift_counts
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (shift_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES shifts (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (payment_method IN ('cash', 'card', 'e_wallet'))
CHECK (discrepancy_minor = counted_amount_minor - expected_amount_minor)

data.name: customers
constraints: CHECK (status IN ('active', 'archived', 'anonymized', 'merged'))
CHECK ((status = 'merged' AND merged_into_customer_id IS NOT NULL) OR (status <> 'merged' AND merged_into_customer_id IS NULL))
FOREIGN KEY (merged_into_customer_id, organization_id) REFERENCES customers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: sales
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (register_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES registers (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (shift_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES shifts (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (inventory_transaction_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (customer_id, organization_id) REFERENCES customers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'completed', 'voided', 'partially_returned', 'returned', 'sync_rejected'))
CHECK ((status = 'draft' AND completed_at IS NULL) OR (status <> 'draft' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL))
CHECK (discount_minor <= subtotal_minor)

data.name: sale_items
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (sale_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES sales (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (stock_location_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (discount_amount_minor <= gross_amount_minor)

data.name: payments
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (sale_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES sales (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (shift_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES shifts (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (payment_method IN ('cash', 'card', 'e_wallet'))
CHECK (tendered_amount_minor = applied_amount_minor + change_amount_minor)
CHECK ((payment_method = 'cash') OR change_amount_minor = 0)

data.name: sale_discounts
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (sale_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES sales (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (sale_item_id, sale_id) REFERENCES sale_items (id, sale_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (discount_scope IN ('item', 'sale'))
CHECK (discount_type = 'fixed_amount')
CHECK ((discount_scope = 'item' AND sale_item_id IS NOT NULL) OR (discount_scope = 'sale' AND sale_item_id IS NULL))

data.name: receipt_sequences
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (register_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES registers (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: receipt_print_jobs
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (register_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES registers (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: approval_requests
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (request_type IN ('sale_return', 'sale_void'))
CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled'))
CHECK ((status = 'pending' AND resolved_at IS NULL) OR (status <> 'pending' AND resolved_at IS NOT NULL))

data.name: approval_decisions
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (approval_request_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES approval_requests (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (decision IN ('approved', 'rejected'))

data.name: sale_returns
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (sale_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES sales (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (inventory_transaction_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (approval_request_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES approval_requests (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (correction_type IN ('return', 'void'))
CHECK (status IN ('completed', 'sync_rejected'))
CHECK (discount_minor <= subtotal_minor)
CHECK ((approval_request_id IS NULL AND approved_by_user_id IS NULL AND approved_at IS NULL) OR (approval_request_id IS NOT NULL AND approved_by_user_id IS NOT NULL AND approved_at IS NOT NULL))

data.name: sale_return_items
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (sale_return_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES sale_returns (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (destination_stock_location_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (disposition IN ('restock', 'damaged', 'non_restock'))
CHECK ((disposition = 'non_restock' AND destination_stock_location_id IS NULL) OR (disposition <> 'non_restock' AND destination_stock_location_id IS NOT NULL))
CHECK (discount_minor <= subtotal_minor)

data.name: refund_payments
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (sale_return_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES sale_returns (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (shift_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES shifts (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (refund_method IN ('cash', 'card', 'e_wallet', 'store_credit'))
CHECK ((refund_method = 'cash' AND shift_id IS NOT NULL AND cash_movement_id IS NOT NULL) OR (refund_method <> 'cash' AND cash_movement_id IS NULL))

data.name: stock_transfers
constraints: CHECK (source_branch_id <> destination_branch_id)

data.name: stock_transfer_items
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (transfer_id, organization_id) REFERENCES stock_transfers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (received_quantity_milli + damaged_quantity_milli <= shipped_quantity_milli)
CHECK ((damaged_quantity_milli = 0) OR (damaged_stock_location_id IS NOT NULL))

data.name: transfer_events
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (transfer_id, organization_id) REFERENCES stock_transfers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: supplier_contacts
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id, organization_id) REFERENCES suppliers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (email IS NOT NULL OR phone IS NOT NULL)

data.name: supplier_products
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id, organization_id) REFERENCES suppliers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: purchase_orders
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id, organization_id) REFERENCES suppliers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: purchase_order_items
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (purchase_order_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES purchase_orders (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (received_quantity_milli + cancelled_quantity_milli <= ordered_quantity_milli)

data.name: goods_receipts
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (purchase_order_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES purchase_orders (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id, organization_id) REFERENCES suppliers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (stock_location_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES stock_locations (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: goods_receipt_items
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (goods_receipt_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES goods_receipts (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (product_id, organization_id) REFERENCES products (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (inventory_transaction_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES inventory_transactions (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: customer_addresses
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id, organization_id) REFERENCES customers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: customer_notes
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (customer_id, organization_id) REFERENCES customers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: loyalty_accounts
constraints: CHECK (status IN ('active', 'disabled', 'closed', 'merged'))
FOREIGN KEY (customer_id, organization_id) REFERENCES customers (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: loyalty_ledger_entries
constraints: CHECK (entry_type IN ('earn', 'redeem', 'adjustment', 'expiry', 'reversal', 'merge_in', 'merge_out'))
FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (account_id, organization_id) REFERENCES loyalty_accounts (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (sale_id, organization_id, branch_id) REFERENCES sales (id, organization_id, branch_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: branch_settings
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

data.name: number_sequences
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((branch_id IS NULL AND branch_scope = '*') OR (branch_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_scope = branch_id))

data.name: reason_codes
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((branch_id IS NULL AND branch_scope = '*') OR (branch_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_scope = branch_id))

data.name: feature_flags
constraints: FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK ((branch_id IS NULL AND branch_scope = '*') OR (branch_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_scope = branch_id))

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_metadata" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "command_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "aggregate_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "causal_group_id" TEXT NULL, "depends_on_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "evidence_json" TEXT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempt_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "next_attempt_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox_dependencies" ("operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sync_outbox (operation_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "depends_on_operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sync_outbox (operation_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("operation_id", "depends_on_operation_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("cursor_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NULL, "projection" TEXT NULL, "permission_digest" TEXT NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "last_change_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_synced_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cursor_key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_snapshot_staging_records" ("snapshot_token" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "collection" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "page_checksum" TEXT NOT NULL, "watermark" INTEGER NOT NULL, "staged_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("snapshot_token", "collection", "record_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_conflicts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolution_status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "resolved_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_entity_versions" ("entity_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NULL, "entity_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(remote_version >= 0), "last_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity_key"), UNIQUE ("organization_id", "entity_type", "entity_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "local_audit_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "operation_id" TEXT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NULL, "actor_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "branch_id" TEXT NULL, "device_id" TEXT NULL, "action_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "metadata_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "organizations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Manila', "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "branches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "timezone" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Asia/Manila', "address_line_one" TEXT NULL, "address_line_two" TEXT NULL, "city" TEXT NULL, "province" TEXT NULL, "postal_code" TEXT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NULL, "receipt_display_name" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "allow_negative_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_negative_stock" IN (0, 1)), "adjustment_approval_threshold_milli" INTEGER NULL CHECK(adjustment_approval_threshold_milli IS NULL OR adjustment_approval_threshold_milli >= 0), "allow_multiple_open_shifts_per_user" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_multiple_open_shifts_per_user" IN (0, 1)), "allow_sales_without_open_shift" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allow_sales_without_open_shift" IN (0, 1)), "cash_discrepancy_approval_threshold_minor" INTEGER NULL CHECK(cash_discrepancy_approval_threshold_minor IS NULL OR cash_discrepancy_approval_threshold_minor >= 0), "discount_approval_threshold_basis_points" INTEGER NULL CHECK(discount_approval_threshold_basis_points IS NULL OR (discount_approval_threshold_basis_points >= 0 AND discount_approval_threshold_basis_points <= 10000)), "return_approval_threshold_minor" INTEGER NULL CHECK(return_approval_threshold_minor IS NULL OR return_approval_threshold_minor >= 0), "void_window_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 15 CHECK(void_window_minutes >= 0), "transfer_approval_threshold_milli" INTEGER NULL CHECK(transfer_approval_threshold_milli IS NULL OR transfer_approval_threshold_milli >= 0), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(version >= 0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("organization_id", "code"), UNIQUE ("id", "organization_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "firebase_uid" TEXT NULL, "email" TEXT NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "invited_at" TEXT NULL, "activated_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(version >= 0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("organization_id", "email"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "roles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(version >= 0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("organization_id", "code"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "permissions" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "role_permissions" ("role_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "permission_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES permissions (code) ON DELETE CASCADE, "granted_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("role_id", "permission_code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_role_assignments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "branch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES branches (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES app_users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "role_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES roles (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "assigned_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "revoked_at" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(version >= 0), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("organization_id", "normalized_name"), UNIQUE ("id", "organization_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "units" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "abbreviation" TEXT NOT NULL, "allows_fractional" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("allows_fractional" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("organization_id", "code"), UNIQUE ("id", "organization_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reason_codes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "branch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES branches (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "branch_scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "requires_note" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("requires_note" IN (0, 1)), "is_active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("is_active" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(version >= 0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("id", "organization_id"), FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK ((branch_id IS NULL AND branch_scope = '*') OR (branch_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_scope = branch_id)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "feature_flags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "branch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES branches (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, "branch_scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "flag_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "configuration_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(version >= 0), "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("id", "organization_id"), FOREIGN KEY (branch_id, organization_id) REFERENCES branches (id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT, CHECK ((branch_id IS NULL AND branch_scope = '*') OR (branch_id IS NOT NULL AND branch_scope = branch_id)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pos_carts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "organization_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES organizations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "branch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES branches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_user_id" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active', 'held')), "title" TEXT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES customers (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "sale_discount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "sale_discount_reason" TEXT NULL, "active_scope" TEXT NULL UNIQUE, "checkout_operation_id" TEXT NULL, "checkout_tenders_json" TEXT NULL, "external_payment_approved" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("external_payment_approved" IN (0, 1)), "checkout_attempted_at" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pos_cart_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cart_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES pos_carts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_sku" TEXT NOT NULL, "snapshot_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity_milli > 0), "item_discount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "discount_reason" TEXT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("cart_id", "product_id"));
